title: Expense Policy
text: ## 1. Purpose and Scope

title: Expense Policy
text: This policy explains which expenses may be reimbursed by Atlas Mobility Group when an employee incurs reasonable business costs. The policy applies to employees, contractors with explicit written expense terms, and temporary workers travelling on behalf of the company.

title: Expense Policy
text: This HTML policy is intended to be read together with the Travel Policy PDF and the Per Diem Caps spreadsheet. If two sources conflict, use the following priority order:

title: Expense Policy
text: 1. Country-specific legal rules and tax requirements.

title: Expense Policy
text: 2. Written pre-approval from Finance Operations or the employee's cost center owner.

title: Expense Policy
text: 3. The Travel Policy PDF for travel logistics and approval requirements.

title: Expense Policy
text: 4. This Expense Policy HTML page for evidence and reimbursement rules.

title: Expense Policy
text: 5. The Per Diem Caps spreadsheet for numeric country, city, lodging, meal, and taxi thresholds.

title: Expense Policy
text: Evidence principle:

title: Expense Policy
text: Atlas reimburses business expenses only when the business purpose, date, amount, currency, vendor, and employee connection are reasonably clear.

title: Expense Policy
text: ## 2. Receipt and Evidence Requirements

title: Expense Policy
text: Receipts are required for all expense claims above EUR 10.00. A card transaction alone is not sufficient evidence.

title: Expense Policy
text:
| Evidence item | Required when | Minimum content | Fallback if missing |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Itemized receipt | Meals, hotels, taxis, client entertainment, parking, supplies | Vendor, date, line items or description, tax if available, total amount, currency | Employee must submit missing receipt declaration and manager approval if over EUR 25 |
| Boarding pass | Flights | Passenger name, route, date, flight number or carrier | Airline travel certificate may replace boarding pass |
| Hotel folio | Hotel stays | Guest name, room nights, taxes, breakfast indication, city, total | Booking confirmation alone is not enough if it does not prove payment |
| Attendee list | Client entertainment or group meals above EUR 120 | Names, company, business purpose, host employee, relationship to project | Claim is held until attendee list is provided |

title: Expense Policy
text: Missing evidence does not automatically make an expense non-reimbursable, but it lowers confidence and may trigger manual review. Repeat missing evidence can lead to reimbursement refusal.

title: Expense Policy
text: ## 3. Meals and Daily Subsistence

title: Expense Policy
text: Meal reimbursement must be reasonable for the travel location. The numeric cap is maintained in the Per Diem Caps spreadsheet. The meal cap applies to the reimbursable food portion before non-reimbursable alcohol is removed.

title: Expense Policy
text:
| Meal type | Default rule | Receipt required? | Important limitation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Breakfast | Reimbursable only if not included in hotel rate or event package | Yes if above EUR 10 | Do not claim separate breakfast when hotel folio shows breakfast included |
| Lunch | Reimbursable during business travel or approved offsite meetings | Yes if above EUR 10 | Office cafeteria lunch at home location is not reimbursable |
| Dinner | Reimbursable during overnight business travel or late return after 20:00 | Yes if above EUR 10 | Alcohol must be removed unless client entertainment was pre-approved |
| Snacks and coffee | Allowed only when part of a documented meeting or travel day | Yes if above EUR 10 | Daily personal coffee is not reimbursable |

title: Expense Policy
text: Alcohol rule:

title: Expense Policy
text: Alcohol is not reimbursable for ordinary employee meals. It may be reimbursed only for pre-approved client entertainment with attendee list and business purpose.

title: Expense Policy
text: Tips are reimbursable up to 10% of the pre-tax meal amount where tipping is customary. Tips above 10% require manager approval and a short explanation.

title: Expense Policy
text: ## 4. Client Entertainment and Hospitality

title: Expense Policy
text: Client entertainment is a stricter category than meals. It requires evidence of a real business purpose and cannot be used to bypass meal caps for ordinary team dinners.

title: Expense Policy
text:
| Scenario | Approval required before expense? | Required evidence | Default treatment |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Client dinner below EUR 120 total | No, unless alcohol is included | Receipt, attendee names, business purpose | Reimbursable if reasonable |
| Client dinner above EUR 120 total | Yes | Receipt, attendee list, agenda or opportunity reference | Manual review |
| Alcohol with client meal | Yes | Pre-approval, attendee list, business purpose | Not reimbursable without pre-approval |
| Team celebration | Yes if above EUR 50 per person | Manager approval, attendee count, cost center | Employee morale budget, not travel expense |

title: Expense Policy
text: ## 5. Local Transport, Taxi, Parking, and Public Transit
section_path: 5. Local Transport, Taxi, Parking, and Public Transit

title: Expense Policy
text: Employees should prefer public transport when safe and practical. Taxi rules depend on city and time threshold in the Per Diem Caps spreadsheet. Taxi claims must include origin, destination, date, and business purpose.
section_path: 5. Local Transport, Taxi, Parking, and Public Transit

title: Expense Policy
text: - Taxi from airport to hotel is reimbursable if public transport is unavailable, impractical due to luggage, or travel occurs after the city-specific after-hours threshold.
section_path: 5. Local Transport, Taxi, Parking, and Public Transit

title: Expense Policy
text: - Taxi between office and home is normally not reimbursable unless there is approved overtime ending after 22:00 or a safety concern.
section_path: 5. Local Transport, Taxi, Parking, and Public Transit

title: Expense Policy
text: - Ride-hailing receipts are accepted if they show route or pickup/dropoff information.
section_path: 5. Local Transport, Taxi, Parking, and Public Transit

title: Expense Policy
text: - Parking is reimbursable only during approved business travel or client meetings.
section_path: 5. Local Transport, Taxi, Parking, and Public Transit

title: Expense Policy
text: - Traffic fines, speeding tickets, and private parking violations are never reimbursable.
section_path: 5. Local Transport, Taxi, Parking, and Public Transit

title: Expense Policy
text: ## 6. Private Car and Mileage

title: Expense Policy
text: Private car use should be pre-approved when the one-way distance exceeds 150 km. Mileage rates are maintained in the spreadsheet because they may change with local tax rules.

title: Expense Policy
text:
| Vehicle type | Evidence | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Private car | Route, distance, business purpose, approval if above 150 km one way | Fuel receipts cannot be claimed separately when mileage is claimed |
| Rental car | Rental agreement, fuel receipt, approval if above compact class | Insurance upgrades require business justification |
| Company car | Trip log where required | Do not claim private mileage reimbursement for company car trips |

title: Expense Policy
text: ## 7. Digital Tools and Submission Rules

title: Expense Policy
text: Expense claims must be submitted within 30 calendar days after the trip end date. The preferred submission format is the company expense portal. Each claim should include category, cost center, trip purpose, source currency, and supporting evidence.

title: Expense Policy
text: - Use the exchange rate from the Finance monthly table, not a random card statement rate, unless Finance explicitly asks for the card statement.

title: Expense Policy
text: - Split mixed receipts into reimbursable and non-reimbursable portions.

title: Expense Policy
text: - Submit hotel, meal, taxi, and flight evidence as separate line items when possible.

title: Expense Policy
text: - Do not upload full passport scans unless explicitly requested by Travel Security.

title: Expense Policy
text: ## 8. Non-Reimbursable Expenses

title: Expense Policy
text: The following are normally not reimbursable:

title: Expense Policy
text: - Alcohol without pre-approved client entertainment classification.

title: Expense Policy
text: - Mini-bar, movies, spa, gym day passes, and personal hotel services.

title: Expense Policy
text: - Traffic fines, penalties, private parking violations, and lost ticket fees.

title: Expense Policy
text: - Personal clothing, luggage, headphones, chargers, toiletries, and travel accessories.

title: Expense Policy
text: - Airline seat upgrades, priority boarding, lounge access, and extra legroom unless approved for medical or business reasons.

title: Expense Policy
text: - Expenses submitted more than 90 days late without Finance exception approval.

title: Expense Policy
text: ## 9. FAQ

title: Expense Policy
text: ### Can I claim dinner in Vienna if the receipt includes wine?
section_path: Can I claim dinner in Vienna if the receipt includes wine?

title: Expense Policy
text: You may claim the reimbursable food portion up to the applicable meal cap, but the wine must be removed unless the dinner was approved as client entertainment before the expense occurred.
section_path: Can I claim dinner in Vienna if the receipt includes wine?

title: Expense Policy
text: ### Can I use my credit card statement instead of a receipt?
section_path: Can I use my credit card statement instead of a receipt?

title: Expense Policy
text: No. A card statement proves payment but does not prove business purpose or item-level eligibility.
section_path: Can I use my credit card statement instead of a receipt?

title: Expense Policy
text: ### What if the local cap is lower than the actual hotel price during a conference?
section_path: What if the local cap is lower than the actual hotel price during a conference?

title: Expense Policy
text: The claim may be reimbursed above cap only if the employee obtained pre-approval or documented that no reasonable alternatives were available.
section_path: What if the local cap is lower than the actual hotel price during a conference?
